items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Gene Ware, they used to jam. You know Gene Ware, Harold DeJong, quite a few fellas.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I forgot the name.

Well, they used to rehearse across the street from my house. Now, my other brother, one he still plays. He works with Larry every now and then. They used to rehearse about my house. Gene Ware, they used to jam. You know Gene Ware, Harold DeJong, quite a few fellas. Earl Bostic and all of them had rehearsals. At that time, Larry was making up his band. But every Saturday, they used to have a hall on Clearburn and Columbus.
Is that on the river side?
